Understanding permissions
changes.oldHtml: Understanding permissions

changes.oldText: Each permission consists of four components:
changes.oldHtml: Each permission consists of four components:

changes.oldText: Scope Type: The effective scope to which the permission applies (e.g., Domain, Project, User)
changes.oldHtml: Scope Type: The effective scope to which the permission applies (e.g., Domain, Project, User)

changes.oldText: Target: A specific entity within the effective scope (e.g., a specific domain name, a specific project)
changes.oldHtml: Target: A specific entity within the effective scope (e.g., a specific domain name, a specific project)

changes.oldText: Permission Type: The target on which operations are performed within the permission's effective scope.
changes.oldHtml: Permission Type: The target on which operations are performed within the permission's effective scope.

changes.oldText: Permission: The operations allowed for the permission type. Only operations valid for the selected permission type are shown. Operations are grouped into two categories:
changes.oldHtml: Permission: The operations allowed for the permission type. Only operations valid for the selected permission type are shown. Operations are grouped into two categories:

changes.oldText: Direct: Create, Read, Update, Soft Delete, Hard Delete
changes.oldHtml: Direct: Create, Read, Update, Soft Delete, Hard Delete

changes.oldText: Delegate to Others: Delegate All, Delegate Read, Delegate Update, Delegate Soft Delete, Delegate Hard Delete
changes.oldHtml: Delegate to Others: Delegate All, Delegate Read, Delegate Update, Delegate Soft Delete, Delegate Hard Delete

changes.oldText: No-op and partial-failure behavior
changes.oldHtml: No-op and partial-failure behavior

changes.oldText: When you save permission changes:
changes.oldHtml: When you save permission changes:

changes.oldText: If nothing changed, the modal closes without sending a request and shows the message No changes made.
changes.oldHtml: If nothing changed, the modal closes without sending a request and shows the message No changes made.

changes.oldText: On success, the message Permissions saved successfully. is shown and the card's tags are recomputed.
changes.oldHtml: On success, the message Permissions saved successfully. is shown and the card's tags are recomputed.

changes.oldText: On a partial failure, the modal stays open with the failed cells flagged. A bulk-error modal lists each failed request — the target scope, the permission, and the error message — along with success and failure counts. You can adjust the grid and save again to retry only the cells that failed.
